validation.note: 人工来源只能通过标注者声明与留存证据核验；程序不能证明是谁填写或其判断正确。

parameter_scope: Exploratory development calibration; not a deployment safety threshold.

selection_protocol.dev_objective: compare only the two train-selected normalization winners by equal_class_error
selection_protocol.test_usage: test label content and predictions are excluded from parameter/normalization selection; format/identity validation still applies

warnings: 仅16个历史开发场景，候选320条不是320个独立样本。
本批已多次用于开发；重划test也不能成为未接触的独立测试集。
